Definition: from G5259 and G4126; to sail under the lee of:--sail under.
BiblicalUsage: hypopléō means to sail under the lee of. In Acts 27:4, the text says "we sailed under Cyprus."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hypopléō means to sail under the lee of, nothing more and nothing less.
